title: Resident Evil Degeneration
notes: Physical ARM64 retest on 2026-10-21 with IPA SHA-256 987e29fd4ba6d64312907ae5c3c9526d160a419a5720d2501a1f15fbaa197a31. Visible Options and New Game buttons responded to touch this time; the older displaced-tap observation was not reproduced for these sampled buttons. Easy difficulty passed loading, intro and dialogue into Leon's 3D tutorial. Virtual-pad swipes moved and turned him. Aim raised the pistol; a fire tap reduced ammo from 15 to 14. The in-game phone opened Map and Options, and Resume returned to the same live scene. The earlier intro crop remains a known graphics issue and was not remeasured. Sustained combat, audible output, native saves and emulator save states remain unverified; this is not a full-playability rating.
